MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Breeze feels like a direct next choice after Old Sock because the Clapton and JJ Cale connection matches the relaxed, bluesy guitar music I want now.",
    "Eagles and the Beatles connect with my interest in classic rock, while Second Hand Heart picks up on the country interest suggested by Blown Away, even though those connections are less compelling today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "25 and Earth Wind & Fire Greatest Hits do not connect closely enough with the blues and roots rock I am seeking on this visit.",
    "Days Of Future Passed and Electric Light Orchestra lean toward symphonic or orchestral sounds, whereas I currently want a more grounded, guitar-led sound.",
    "I cannot judge the musical connection of collections with no clear artist, and a large studio-album collection requires more commitment than I want today."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seem to treat a broad interest in classic rock as enough, although the particular blues and roots sound matters more to me right now.",
    "Several hits collections assume that familiar songs are what I want, but familiarity alone does not give me a reason to choose an album."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The specific connection to Old Sock matters more than a loose connection to the same musical era.",
    "My interest in country music is real, but it does not outweigh a direct match to the relaxed bluesy guitar sound I want today.",
    "I rarely choose something unless the connection is strong; an album can fit my general tastes without being something I would select now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my classic and roots rock interests, but only The Breeze captured the specific bluesy connection strong enough to make me choose it today."
}
